name: Legacy Woodworking LLC
old_description: Legacy Woodworking, LLC is proud to offer our professional woodworking services to all of Connecticut,
about:
Legacy Woodworking LLC operates from Meriden, Connecticut, serving clients across Connecticut, New York, New Jersey, and New England. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in architectural millwork, custom cabinetry, and one-of-a-kind pieces that repurpose aeronautic, marine, or industrial materials. Core services include cut-to-size parts on a Holzher Cut 85 horizontal beam saw holding .0001-inch tolerance, edge banding in PVC, plastic laminate, wood veneer, and thin solid wood, and CNC machining on a Holzher Pro Master 7123 for cabinet parts, curved components, and custom fixtures. A computerized labeling system tracks parts through fabrication.

Customers span corporate, institutional, financial services, healthcare, retail, and residential sectors, with projects ranging from commercial casework and reception desks to custom trim and moldings.

Legacy emphasizes precision and versatility, offering job-shop fabrication for clients who need machined parts without investing in jigs or tooling, and highlighting its ability to transform reclaimed industrial components into distinctive furniture.
